title: Mixed Event — Warmth in Every Stitch — Episode3 A Fun Sewing Session

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku feels grateful for all of Mafuyu's help with studying and club activities, and wants to do something in return. When she learns that Mafuyu is looking for ways to improve her home ec project, she offers some embroidery lessons.

rows.Line: A few days later
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness we didn't get lost along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for leading the way.
I'm liking this place's relaxed atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's the perfect place for today's lesson, since they have all the things we need for embroidery available for rent.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it's the sewing lounge. I was wondering where you were taking us, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have you been here before, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, but Mizuki's told me all about it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, hold on... Isn't today when...?
Huh? That looks like...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I knew it! Hi, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is usually when Mizuki comes to do alterations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi, Mizuki...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Shizuku and Haruka too?!
What's going on today?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She brought us here to give us a lesson in embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, can I join you guys?!
Embroidered ribbons are in lately, so I really wanna learn how to make them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
We can make some together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Then, if you don't mind me squeezing in♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do our best today, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I can't believe that I get to learn with you and the others like this, Haruka!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's begin our second embroidery lesson♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have some flowers for you to embroider, Asahina, and penguins for you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Oh, I didn't realize I'd get to choose from all these different types...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but don't worry. They all involve the same stitches I showed you the other day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What about these penguins?
This looks pretty tricky...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not to worry. You should be able to make them, since they only involve using outline stitches.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we'll practice doing some basic stitches, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm ready to learn!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Look at you, Mafuyu!
Your flowers are so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You think so?
I think our teacher here deserves most of the credit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's because you're so talented.
You've only just begun learning, but everything's so well-balanced. I'm very impressed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if you sewed a bead or a button in the middle? That should make it look even cuter!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
Would you mind showing me how to do that, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's finished...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow!
These penguins look so adorably chubby!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I think I've gotten the hang of doing outline stitches.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... In that case, would you like to try coloring it in using another type of stitch?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only will you be able to make it look even cuter, you'll even be able to add a gradation using different colored threads.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, that would allow me to give the babies fluffy feathers, and the emperor penguins their characteristic yellow necks...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please show me, Shizuku.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That should be everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, you're done too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, your flowers are beautiful...
I really love these blue ones with the beads in them. They're so cute and sparkly.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These would make any accessory look really photogenic! I'm gonna give these a shot when I get home♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe we're all finished now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work today, everyone.
I was honestly a little surprised by how quickly you were all able to master everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because you took us through each technique step by step. I have a good feeling about my project now, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. I never imagined being able to embroider adorable penguins like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Same here!
Chatting with all of you while we embroidered was super fun! I hope we get to do this again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all gather again to make our gifts for Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I plan on embroidering a few accessories again this year, so I thought we could make some together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Embroidered accessories... That does sound nice. I do really love the handkerchief that you gave me a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I already have my gifts decided...
But it would be nice to embroider the ribbons that I'm gonna wrap them with♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
What do you think, Asahina? You're still undecided in terms of gifts, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I think I'll join. I did have quite a lot of fun today, after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, that makes all of us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so let's figure out when we can all meet!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is just how I feel, but I believe quite a lot of emotion goes into every stitch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why, for those truly special occasions, I almost always give people things that I embroidered myself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A gift full of emotion...)
bgm_area00002
A few hours later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since your goal is give off an air of mastery, you should probably dial back your smile a little here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, you may want to throw in a subtle wink.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
A smaller smile and a subtle wink.
Thanks, I'll try doing another run now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks for all your support!
You guys are the best!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope you all enjoyed my gift!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, how was that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That was very good...!
It seems like a wonderful way for you to connect with your fans, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I couldn't have done this without you, Shizuku. I really appreciate you watching me practice until the end like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm just glad that I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, how are things going on your end?
Did your embroidery lesson go well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe I was able to teach everything that I had planned. Also...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? You're all gonna meet again to make gifts for Valentine's Day together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm going to make some for everyone in SEKAI, so I hope you'll be looking forward to the day of.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You are? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But making gifts for everyone sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help. I wanna pay you back for helping me practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? Then, would you mind helping me come up with designs for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My goal is to choose the right one for each person. On top of being very knowledgeable, you're close with Miku and the others, so I'd love to hear your opinion.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure thing. I'll do my best to make sure that your gifts for everyone turn out really great.
